Results.ReviewText:
Bought the grill about 3 weeks ago and it is being used about 3 times a week.
Pros: I put it together myself and it took about 45min to do, really easy instructions, good hardware. The Grill heats up quick, retains heat and is super easy to clean. The flavorizer bars help wit flare ups and keep the burners clean, one thing my old grill didn’t have.
Cons: Although it is easy to clean, food tends to burn onto the grates and it is almost impossible to get rid of some of it. I think I’m a little OCD when it comes to it and others may not even notice, just my observation. 
My grill gets a deep clean every other use (grates, flavorizer bars, cook box, outside) and I noticed today that one of the flavorizer bars is damaged. The coating cracked and parts of it fell off (maybe a bad batch, nothing major, will talk to Weber CS about it).
It takes some time to get used to a 3 burner grill (for me who has never had one with more than 1 burner) and it’s a little challenging find the best spot on the grates (for heat, nice dear marks etc), but overall, the grill is awesome and it appears that the heat distribution is pretty even.
It took me 1 year to pull the trigger on a new grill but I’m glad all the research paid off, Weber makes some of the sturdiest and best built grills out there, it doesn’t wobble, not loose screws or attachments and a breeze to use and move.
Results.Title: Good solid Grill

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, we are sorry to hear about the issue you experienced with your grill reaching temperature. It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator.To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:



-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.



-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.



-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.



-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.



-Close the grill lid.



-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

This is how you would want to start the grill each time. If you have further questions please contact our support team. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: It was easy enough to put together. The first half dozen or so times I used it was uneventful. Everything worked as it should. I cleaned the grates before every use with my brush. The last time I used it, after lighting it, the flames were not very big, therefore not putting out much heat. Could not get the grill hot. I probably turned the gas off at the tank probably 5 or 6 times. I turned off the control knobs on the grill and re-lit the same amount of times. Finally after that last time the grill burners produced enough flame to start heating enough to cook my food. I would consider a higher rating if I had a good explanation of how I could prevent this from happening in the future.

We chose this grill because of Weber’s reputation. We were not disappointed! We love everything about it. Everything cooks evenly & well.Grates clean fairly easy. Love how it shows the temperature & how much propane is left.
The grill was not to difficult to put together although it took My husband & I double the time it says it takes! Lol Would be nice if they had everything labeled with letters corresponding in instructions. But again it really isn’t difficult to put together.
Overall we absolutely love this grill! If you’re thinking of purchasing, do it! There is nothing about it that I can think of that we don’t like!
